multi_entity_note: Two parties: Freedom Mortgage Corporation and Cherry Hill Mortgage Investment Corp., with separate notice addresses.
processing_note: All notices or other communications hereunder shall be in writing and shall be deemed given if delivered by receipted hand delivery or mailed by prepaid registered or certified mail (return receipt requested) or by recognized overnight courier addressed as follows:

contract.document_name.rationale: The title and the definition of "Agreement" name it the Strategic Alliance Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The preamble leaves the day and month blank ("made as of  , 2013"), so only the year is stated.

contract.effective_date.rationale: No separate effective date; the agreement runs from the date hereof, which is stated only as the year 2013.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term ends at the later of three years from the date hereof and an event, not stated as a calendar date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 6(g) states the agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement has no renewal provision.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no renewal and so no notice period to prevent renewal.
